DMs glitching for DAYS: Reels send fine, but normal memes/images instantly fail?
Any time I try to send a normal still meme or an image in my DMs, it instantly fails and gives me the red "X" and a black "Failed to send message" banner. To clarify, I am not trying to share anything political or inappropriate, just normal, everyday memes.  
The strangest part is that if I send a video or a Reel, it goes through perfectly fine without a single issue. Other people I know are working completely normally, so this is only happening to my specific account.  
Since it's been going on for days, it doesn't seem like a quick temporary outage. Has anyone successfully fixed this, or is anyone else dealing with this exact same issue right now?
